messages:
maria: Noticed recurring 99p tail on shared GPUs in rack-9 tied to TOR egress spikes after onboarding tenant 'glimmer'.

lee: Chart?

maria: telemetry: /api/query?m=tor_egress_bytes&rack=rack-9&window=2m -> peaks ~900Mbps when glimmer profiling runs.

sana: That rack is mixed fractional + shared. Small NVLINK hiccups there amplify into slab churn.

maria: Proposal: gentle throttle then soft-evacuate flow. Sequence: 1) throttle tenant egress to 600Mbps for 2m; 2) if >750Mbps persists for 30s -> annotate slice soft-evacuate and stop packing new fractional allocs to that rack; 3) cooldown 10m to prevent oscillation. Reserved/dedicated slices exempt.

lee: Concern: cache warmup cost and billing. We should simulate a 3m burst in canary to measure kvcache miss rate and token delta. Also surface cost estimate in console modal.

sana: Agree. Add an alert: if >3 evacuations/hr trigger ops review. Also prefer throttling as default before evacuation to reduce churn.

maria: I'll draft runbook + PR for annotator and throttle hook. Devops-bot: created canary rollout plan -> feature/egress-soft-evacuate -> eu-west-1 canary. Link: https://deploys.internal/rollouts/9001 :rocket:

lee: Assign maria to own the rollout, sana to add cooldown logic to allocator, I'll loop in billing for surge charge policy.

maria: I'll post canary results and KV metrics here after run.
